title: Warp
description: Engineering-notebook light: a pale lavender-white page under a faint dot grid, violet-black ink in five strengths, square buttons and 1px ink frames, an electric ultramarine for active tabs, code keys and the deepest panels, and a single citron button. Monospace for headings and body with a geometric sans for card titles. Dark sibling: violet-black page, brighter ultramarine.
notes: Azeret Mono is the original's own open font (body, headings, code); Figtree stands in for its closed geometric sans (card titles, via font-display)
highlight = the citron button colour; glow = the soft violet of chart lines
sets --warp-squeeze (0.1em), which the warp blocks subtract from their letter-spacing to match the original's narrower mono
name: warp-theme
